## Checklist

- [ ] No real captures, decoded strings, secrets or private identifiers included.
- [ ] Regression tests cover the changed success and failure paths.
- [ ] Existing capture/index semantics and explicit uncertainty are preserved.
- [ ] Help, docs and changelog updated where needed.
